why.T3-023: The item is the sub's own April Fools switch: moderator resigns to Nvidiayy, Novideo CSS is mentioned, and the subreddit's own joke is posted, so it is a staged change to the sub's state rather than a member fake or an outside claim.

why.T3-011: The item is chiefly help sent or attempted across neighboring university rooms: calling to help UVic, agreeing to help Canada and Canucks, and an attempted help being repixelated; the requests are present but the help given or attempted carries the theme.

why.T3-005: The corner is under invasion by Blue and other colors, with calls to defend, hold, retake and not surrender; repair and upkeep concepts are folded into that fight.

why.T3-121: The item polices people said to harm Blue by asking moderators to ban an opponent and publicly blaming a person, i.e. exclusion or shunning of a vandal rather than merely tracing or pleading.

why.T3-044: The tag and sign are made and defended as lettering that directs lost cubers to the subreddit, so the mark's point is bringing visitors to the sub.

why.T3-037: The two concepts directly dispute whether the canvas effort is worth caring about, with indifference and refusal to stop others having fun.

why.T3-031: The room celebrates its carrot-themed replies to a taunt, playing the room's own joke in canvas talk rather than the taunt itself.

why.T3-006: The item is a run of calls to attack, consume, erase or black out named artworks, flags, coordinates and communities, which is the gate for calling to deface rivals' work.

why.T3-009: The post-shutdown turns mark the final logo as achieved, with pride, thanks and gladness that fixes were made; the recounting is in service of celebrating the finished work.

why.T3-038: The core practice is drawing and reporting the r/signal mark together, including locating the active drawing and announcing it is done, rather than only proposing or crediting it.

why.T3-174: The item performs membership in the Void colour faction through hails, creeds, chants, blessings and declarations of belonging, so it is professing loyalty to the colour.

why.T3-150: The explicit alliance with r/bulgaria, agreement to the offered alliance, and listing of mutual protection agreements make joint defence the leading deal.
why.T3-010: The relaying of a move request and the offer of a good border are a border and space settlement with neighbours.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-150 alone would not carry the move request and border offer; T3-010 alone would not carry the named alliance and mutual protection agreements.
